sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B | Awesome Agents
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B is the middleweight of the Qwen 3.5 Small Series and the model that makes the strongest case for what 4 billion parameters can do in 2026. It approaches the previous generation's Qwen3-30B on MMLU-Pro, beats GPT-5-Nano across vision benchmarks, and handles text, images, and video natively - all from roughly 8GB of VRAM at full precision.
